phrases.latin: Avus, avia, pater, Theodōrus in trīclīniō prandērunt
phrases.english: Grandpa, Grandma, Dad and Theo had lunch in the dining room
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 342.
